SELECT /* LGVPAY00022.retrievePayrollRunList */ pce.payroll_calculation_exec_id , pce.payroll_calculation_set_id , pacs.payroll_calculation_set_name , TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(pcpb.payroll_calc_period_value,'yyyymm'),'mm/yyyy') AS payroll_calc_period_value , pce.payroll_type_code AS payroll_type_code , cccm.common_code_name AS payroll_type_name , TO_CHAR(pce.basis_date,'dd/mm/yyyy') AS basis_date , SUM(CASE WHEN pcee.error_flag = 'Y' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END ) AS normal_count , TO_CHAR(MAX(pce.creation_date),'dd/mm/yyyy hh24:mi:ss') AS creation_date ,(SELECT um.user_name FROM lgcom_user_m um WHERE TO_CHAR(um.application_user_id) = pce.creation_user_id) AS created_by
FROM tb_pay_calc_period_basis_n pcpb , tb_pay_calc_exec_n pce , lgcom_common_code_multi_lang_c cccm , tb_pay_calc_emp_exec_n pcee , tb_pay_calc_set_n pacs
WHERE pcpb.payroll_calc_period_value = TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(#{payrollCalcPeriodValue},'mm/yyyy'),'yyyymm') AND pcpb.subsidiary_Code = #{LGVHR_PROJECT_SESSION.subsidiaryCode} AND pce.basis_date BETWEEN to_date(pcpb.start_yyyymmdd,'yyyymmdd') AND to_date(pcpb.end_yyyymmdd,'yyyymmdd') AND NVL(pce.confirm_flag, 'N') = 'Y' /* 확정 건 */ AND cccm.code_type_code = 'LGVHR_PAY_RUN_TYPE' AND pce.payroll_type_code = cccm.common_code AND cccm.language_code = #{USER_SESSION.languageCode} AND pcee.payroll_calculation_exec_id(+) = pce.payroll_calculation_exec_id AND pacs.payroll_calculation_set_id = pce.payroll_calculation_set_id
GROUP BY pce.payroll_calculation_exec_id , pce.payroll_calculation_set_id , pacs.payroll_calculation_set_name , TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(pcpb.payroll_calc_period_value,'yyyymm'),'mm/yyyy') , pce.payroll_type_code , cccm.common_code_name , TO_CHAR(pce.basis_date,'dd/mm/yyyy') , pce.creation_user_id ORDER BY 1 DESC
